question: During lunch break, eight colleagues, namely A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting in a circle facing the centre at equal distances. B is an immediate neighbor of both G and D. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and G. H is third to the left of B. E is not an immediate neighbour of A. Who is third to the right of E?
